approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: Outlook-style HTML may place From, Sent, To and Subject labels on one visible line before quoted history.
Keep the explicit From-plus-secondary-header boundary, preserve current-message role classification, add no dependency, and advance the parser version.
title: Outlook inline quoted-header boundary
objective: Recognize an explicit Outlook From header plus Sent, Date, To or Subject labels even when they share one visible HTML line, so older quoted text cannot change the current RFI or email role.
